content.text:
Does this text message actually offer that CO will call THEM — Co proposing to place an outbound call to the person, not just telling them how they can call Co themselves — in any wording, even indirectly (e.g. "I'm here if you want to talk this through")? Not just related to talking or listening in general — specifically Co offering to call them.

Message: "That's great, congrats on locking it in.

Next up is usually the headcount and a final guest list, since that drives everything else, catering, seating, even the room layout they give you. After that, think about whether you want a caterer or the venue handles food, and when you want invites out by.

Want me to look for a caterer or any other vendor for the 14th?"

Return ONLY "yes" or "no".
